name: Tinergy Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: Tinergy Chemical Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the production and sale of titanium dioxide in China and internationally. The company offers titanium dioxide, ferrous sulfate, phosphate rock, yellow phosphorus, ferric phosphate, modified polyacrylamide, sulfuric acid residue, and new chemical products. It is also involved in logistics and transportation services; waste heat power generation; trading; investments activities; chemical engineering and equipment design; technology development; consulting; and transfer services.
